actions.name: drink_water
actions.text: a person raises one hand to the mouth and tilts the head back
paraphrases: a person lifts the right hand to the lips and leans the head back
a person brings one hand up to the mouth while the head tips backward
a person holds the right hand at the mouth and tilts the head upward briefly
actions.motion: The right arm bends at the elbow and the right hand rises from waist level to the mouth. The head tilts backward while the hand stays near the mouth for a moment. The hand then lowers back down to the front of the body and the head returns upright.

phases.start: right hand rises from waist toward mouth
phases.middle: hand held at mouth, head tilted back

confusable_with.name: eat_meal
confusable_with.visible_difference: eating repeats short hand-to-mouth trips without tilting the head back

confusable_with.name: brush_teeth
confusable_with.visible_difference: brushing keeps the hand at the mouth with fast small side-to-side motion

confusable_with.name: cheers_and_drink
confusable_with.visible_difference: cheers involves a second person and an arm extension toward them before drinking

actions.name: eat_meal
actions.text: a person repeatedly moves one hand from the table area to the mouth
paraphrases: a person brings the right hand up to the mouth again and again
a person makes several trips with one hand between the lap and the mouth
a person, usually seated, lifts a hand to the mouth repeatedly while leaning slightly forward
actions.motion: The person, often seated, keeps the torso slightly forward. The right hand moves from in front of the body near waist height up to the mouth and back down, repeating several times. The head may dip slightly toward the hand each time; the left hand stays low in front of the body.

phases.start: hands low in front of body
phases.end: hand rests low in front of body

confusable_with.name: drink_water
confusable_with.visible_difference: drinking is a single longer hand-to-mouth hold with the head tilting back

confusable_with.name: brush_teeth
confusable_with.visible_difference: brushing keeps the hand at the mouth instead of moving up and down

confusable_with.name: sneeze_cough
confusable_with.visible_difference: sneezing brings the hand to the face once with a sudden forward jerk of the head and torso

actions.name: brush_teeth
actions.text: a person holds one hand at the mouth moving it quickly side to side
paraphrases: a person keeps the right hand near the mouth with fast small back-and-forth motion
a person rubs one hand back and forth in front of the mouth repeatedly
a person makes rapid short horizontal hand motions held at the level of the mouth
actions.motion: The right arm bends sharply and the right hand rises to the mouth. The hand stays at the mouth and moves quickly in short side-to-side or up-and-down strokes many times. The elbow stays raised out to the side, and the head stays mostly still; at the end the hand lowers.

phases.middle: fast repeated small strokes at the mouth

confusable_with.name: eat_meal
confusable_with.visible_difference: eating moves the hand down and up between mouth and lap

confusable_with.name: wipe_face
confusable_with.visible_difference: wiping covers a larger area of the face with broader strokes, often with both hands

confusable_with.name: phone_call
confusable_with.visible_difference: phone call holds the hand still at the side of the head by the ear

actions.name: brush_hair
actions.text: a person repeatedly moves one hand over the top and side of the head
paraphrases: a person sweeps the right hand along the head from front to back repeatedly
a person raises one hand above the head and strokes downward several times
a person makes repeated combing strokes with one raised hand along the head
actions.motion: The right arm lifts with the elbow raised high and the hand placed at the top or side of the head. The hand moves from the top of the head down and back toward the neck or shoulder, then returns up, repeating several times. The head may tilt slightly toward the brushing side.

phases.start: right hand rises to top of head
phases.middle: repeated downward strokes along the head

confusable_with.name: flick_hair
confusable_with.visible_difference: flicking hair is a single quick outward sweep rather than repeated strokes

confusable_with.name: headache
confusable_with.visible_difference: headache holds the hand still against the head instead of stroking

confusable_with.name: put_on_a_hat_cap
confusable_with.visible_difference: putting on a hat uses both hands that lower once onto the top of the head

actions.name: drop
actions.text: a person opens a held hand in front of the body letting something fall
paraphrases: a person holds one hand out in front and then releases, with little arm motion
a person extends the right hand forward and lets go, then lowers the arm
a person releases something from one hand at waist height and looks down after it
actions.motion: The right hand is held in front of the body at about waist or chest height. The arm stays nearly still while the hand opens, and the head often tilts down to look at the floor. The arm then lowers to the side; the person does not bend down.

phases.start: hand held out in front of the body

confusable_with.name: pick_up
confusable_with.visible_difference: picking up bends the torso and knees to bring the hand down to the floor

confusable_with.name: throw
confusable_with.visible_difference: throwing swings the arm quickly forward from behind the shoulder

confusable_with.name: toss_a_coin
confusable_with.visible_difference: tossing flicks the hand upward and the head follows upward

actions.name: pick_up
actions.text: a person bends down to reach the floor and then straightens up
paraphrases: a person leans forward and lowers one hand to the ground, then stands upright
a person bends the torso and knees, reaches down, and rises again
a person stoops to bring a hand near the feet before returning to standing
actions.motion: From standing, the torso bends forward and the knees bend so the hips lower. The right arm extends down until the hand is near the floor in front of the feet. The person then straightens the knees and torso, bringing the hand back up to the front of the body.

phases.middle: torso bent, hand near the floor
phases.end: standing again with hand in front of body

confusable_with.name: squat_down
confusable_with.visible_difference: squatting keeps the torso upright and the hands do not reach the floor

confusable_with.name: drop
confusable_with.visible_difference: dropping does not bend the body and the hand stays at waist height

confusable_with.name: put_on_a_shoe
confusable_with.visible_difference: putting on a shoe keeps both hands at one foot for a long time, often seated or with one foot raised

actions.name: throw
actions.text: a person swings one arm from behind the shoulder forward and releases quickly
paraphrases: a person draws the right arm back and then whips it forward fast
a person cocks one hand behind the head and snaps the arm forward
a person pulls an arm back then extends it rapidly forward while stepping forward
actions.motion: The right arm draws back so the hand is behind and above the right shoulder, and the torso rotates slightly to the right. The arm then swings quickly forward and extends, while the torso turns forward and weight shifts onto the front foot. The arm follows through downward and returns to the side.

phases.middle: fast forward swing and arm extension

confusable_with.name: shoot_at_basket
confusable_with.visible_difference: shooting pushes both hands upward from in front of the face

confusable_with.name: throw_up_cap_hat
confusable_with.visible_difference: throwing up a cap moves the hand from the head straight up rather than forward

confusable_with.name: punch_slap
confusable_with.visible_difference: punching has a second person and the hand stops at the partner's body

actions.name: sit_down
actions.text: a person lowers the hips from standing to a seated position
paraphrases: a person bends the knees and hips and settles into a seat
a person goes from upright standing to sitting with the hips lowered
a person leans slightly forward and lowers the hips down into a seated position
actions.motion: From standing, the person bends the knees and hips while the torso leans slightly forward. The hips move backward and down until they stop at seat height. The torso then returns upright with the thighs roughly horizontal and the feet staying on the floor.

phases.middle: knees and hips bend, hips move down and back

confusable_with.name: stand_up
confusable_with.visible_difference: standing up moves the hips upward, the reverse direction

confusable_with.name: squat_down
confusable_with.visible_difference: squatting lowers the hips further with heels near the hips and no support behind

confusable_with.name: falling_down
confusable_with.visible_difference: falling is fast and uncontrolled and ends with the body on the ground

actions.name: stand_up
actions.text: a person rises from a seated position to standing upright
paraphrases: a person leans forward and straightens the legs to get up from sitting
a person lifts the hips up from a seat until fully standing
a person goes from sitting with bent knees to standing with straight legs
actions.motion: The person starts seated with knees bent and hips low. The torso leans forward, the hands may push down near the thighs, and the knees and hips extend to raise the hips. The torso returns upright and the person ends standing with straight legs.

confusable_with.name: sit_down
confusable_with.visible_difference: sitting down moves the hips downward, the reverse direction

confusable_with.name: jump_up
confusable_with.visible_difference: jumping starts from standing and the whole body leaves the floor

confusable_with.name: pick_up
confusable_with.visible_difference: picking up starts standing and bends down before rising

actions.name: clapping
actions.text: a person repeatedly brings both hands together in front of the chest
paraphrases: a person strikes the two palms together several times at chest height
a person moves both hands apart and together again and again in front
a person claps by bringing the hands together repeatedly in front of the body
actions.motion: Both arms bend so the hands are in front of the chest. The hands move apart sideways a short distance and then come together to touch, repeating many times at a steady rhythm. The elbows stay near the torso and the rest of the body stays still.

phases.start: both hands rise to chest height
phases.middle: repeated meeting and separating of the hands

confusable_with.name: rub_two_hands
confusable_with.visible_difference: rubbing keeps the hands in contact and slides them against each other

confusable_with.name: put_palms_together
confusable_with.visible_difference: palms together is a single joining that is held still

confusable_with.name: high-five
confusable_with.visible_difference: high-five has two people and one raised hand meets the partner's hand
